gate_policy: Fail closed. An unmeasured control gate is None and does NOT count as a pass.

namespace_isolation.note: Cache key includes model id, prompt/schema hash and packet hash; a legacy or V1 response can never be served to V2.

request_leakage_audit.method: leakage.audit_packet + leakage.audit_serialized_request on every materialized packet (reference + transformed) and its exact serialized request; a finding refuses the call.

scoring_rubric.B_query_compilability: fraction of accepted hypotheses compiling to plans
scoring_rubric.C_evidence_grounding: fraction citing only real packet evidence ids
scoring_rubric.D_capability_awareness: rate of requests for unavailable data
scoring_rubric.F_relevance: deterministic family x metric x condition relevance
scoring_rubric.G_non_redundancy: median redundancy_rate over distinct normalized intents
scoring_rubric.H_metric_richness: median distinct metrics and families per fixture
scoring_rubric.I_identity_robustness: median intent Jaccard under synthetic alias swap
scoring_rubric.J_evidence_sensitivity: fraction of real perturbations that move intent
scoring_rubric.K_irrelevant_invariance: fraction of irrelevant changes that do NOT move intent
scoring_rubric.L_abstention_quality: abstention rate on deliberately starved packets

token_and_cost_estimate.measurement: input tokens are chars/4 of the EXACT serialized request (system prompt + user message + tool schema) for each of the 64 frozen calls; output is a frozen ESTIMATE from Sonnet 4.6's own observed distribution.
